headline.title: 芯片股溃败加深全球股市抛售，美债因避险需求上涨
headline.summary: 全球股市抛售加剧，华尔街和亚洲芯片股暴跌，进一步逆转今年人工智能交易的火爆涨势。美债因避险需求上涨，美元走弱。
headline.title_en: Stock Losses Deepen on Chip Rout, Treasuries Rally: Markets Wrap
headline.summary_en: A global equity selloff deepened as chip stocks plunged on Wall Street and in Asia, further unwinding this year’s AI trade rally. Treasuries gained on haven demand, while the dollar weakened.
